title: Keep detached notifications safe when Linux TERMAL_CLI uses a host-PID fallback
outcome: A detached notification launched during the Linux post-install fallback window cannot silently lose completion or execute an unrelated recycled-PID image after the host exits.
acceptance: Cover a detached notifier whose inherited CLI initially resolves through a live host PID, then that host exits before notification.
Refuse the unsupported detached notification before launch or use a durable verified executable source at completion, without invoking a recycled PID's unrelated image.
